transcript.text: How is everybody doing? Welcome back to another Dragon Wilds video. In this video, I'm going to go over some raid
tips, how to make your raid runs more efficient, as well as how to farm. Because currently, as you guys know, I
don't think the raid is currently set up in its intended fashion. As we know, when you complete the raid and you do go
back to Zilyana and you reset it, all the puzzles reset for the most part, but most of the enemies, if not all of them,
do not respawn. I do think that this is not intended and this is currently a bug. I have not really seen or any notes
specifically from the developers telling us that this is a bug itself, but we can just assume that it is. So, one of the
earlier locations that you can farm enemies in order to get materials. As you guys can see, I just did one run
with the raid itself and this is all I've collected, you know, discord residue. I got plenty of it. I got black
dragon hide. Now, some of these materials and some of these food items are from chests. So, you can farm up the
chests while you're doing this run, but for the most part, we're going for enemies themselves because currently in
the raid, they do not respawn. So, your first location that you want to go to, pretty straightforward, it's going to be
right here at the earlier stage. So, this is where you start the raid, then you make it across, then you do like
your general encounter with Zilyana to kind of introduce you to the raid, then you go over here and you have these
zombies. Now, these zombies are pretty decent to farm. The thing about them, the respawn time is pretty long. So,
this isn't the top location I would pick. This is an option for you. As you guys can see, so we farmed up a few.
Just so you guys know, there is actually a chest right here. If you haven't gotten that one. So, if you're farming
here, you can grab that chest, get yourself some more ingredients. So, as you can see, we killed the enemies, but
they're not respawning. You can also go inside here and kill these skeletons. Those guys will respawn. Their respawn
timer is pretty long as well. So, this is location number one that's pretty decent for farming. Let's move on to
what I believe is the best location currently in the raid in order to farm new materials, as well as enemies, due
to the fact that nobody's responding in this raid. It's a raid, guys. Come on. So, here's our first teleporter. We're
going to go into this town. Already took out a lot of these guys. Again, every time you do this, like every time you
reset your raid, you're going to want to go for chests if you can. Here we go. Get out a wand. We don't usually use
wands, but we will this time. So, by far the best location to farm enemies is going to be here inside the Gorn Feld
Keep. What you're going to want to do is make your way up this path and come over here to the graveyard.
This is one of the locations that we actually have to whoop whoop whoop. You guys can't get me. Oh my gosh, he got
me. So, as you can see, before I even killed all of the skeletons, a new one already spawned.
That's why this location is better than the zombies because the zombie spawn rate is a lot longer.
So, then you're going to wait. You can just walk around this area. Go in here. This thing seems to activate them. At
least it's kind of like what I've seen is like sometimes getting on this will activate their spawn. Then I'll run
around. Now guys, again, you know, I know this isn't ideal. The raid needs to be fixed. It's completely bugged, but
currently this is the best way in order for you to farm materials. And you're basically just going to sit here and
farm up these guys as they continue to spawn in. Location of it is going to be right here, the Gorn Feld Fortress. This
is the best location currently in order to farm materials for Scorned Wilderness. Again, guys, obviously we
know this isn't supposed to be intended like this. I hope the devs are working on this. Again, I haven't seen them
actually talk about the raid being bugged. Pretty sure they know and it's something that they're thinking with,
but um yeah, I just can't wait for the raid to completely reset. That way we could take on all the mini bosses again,
you know, the abyssal demons, things like that. Now, another quick tip for you guys with the raid. There's so many
different skips you can do. Now, currently can't really show you guys it actively because I'm currently at the
end of the raid. Let's say you're here. When you get into Val Hollow part of the raid, this is Death's Church, and you
come over to here. You're like, "Okay, I want to go, you know, continue progressing. I'm on a new run." Instead
of actually walking this entire path and going all the way over there, what you're going to do is jump off the
map and skip. And what that's going to do, it's actually going to skip the entire dungeon section, this entire
parkour section to get you over to here. All you need to do is just jump off the map. Right before you die, pause the
game. You're going to do hold to reset position, reset position. And when you reset position, you're going to spawn at
the starting church in a Bramble Mead. You're going to go here. You are going to load back into Ziliana. And from
doing that, you're going to go I'm ready. It's going to allow you to go to Cataclysm's Keep. So, it's basically
going to completely skip the Shattered Stronghold. Now, keep in mind, multiple sections of the raid have the same
mechanic because the way it works, the way it works basically is these teleporters, when you get close enough
to them, they activate. Currently, it seems like it's bugged because you don't actually need to be close to them to
activate it. In order to activate this teleporter, you have to be in here, basically. So, when you're over here and
you're in this Keep, it technically has activated this teleporter. So, if you go down reset position, you can instantly
just spawn here because this spawn point opens up. So, it's just a quick video going over how to farm the new materials
with Scorned Wilderness because the raid is currently bugged, it seems like, as well as how to do some skips for the
raid itself. If you guys enjoyed this video, drop a like on it and subscribe for all things Dragon Wilds. It's what

I agree with the comment that says that the area with the Zombies and the Skeletons is a better farm spot.
Zombies take 1min and 40 seconds to respawn on kill, but has a chance to pop an extra zombie.
Skeletons respawn in only 1min and they also have a chance to drop x2 residue.
My route would be Zom, Skels, Skels, Zom, Skel, then repeat.
Was able to farm 99 pretty easy once you get a good flow going.
